blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Diffusion-based video matting has recently emerged as a leading approach, leveraging video diffusion priors from internet-scale pretraining to achieve strong zero-shot generalization from limited synthetic data. However, the heavy compute of these diffusion backbones limits inference to a short chunk of just 6 to 24 frames, so even ordinary videos span multiple chunks. Because each chunk is matted independently from coarse mask guidance, existing methods fail to maintain consistency across chunk boundaries, producing flickering edges and discontinuous transparency. We address this with a mask-guided diffusion-matting framework built on two ideas. The RGB and mask conditioning are represented as separate token streams that interact through full spatio-temporal self-attention, letting the model adaptively combine fine RGB texture with coarse mask layout rather than committing to a fixed channel-wise fusion. On top of this, we propose a novel pair of learnable embeddings, the preserve token and the refine token, that act as a per-frame conditioning interface and enable a sliding-window inference scheme in which already-generated mattes are propagated across chunk boundaries for local temporal consistency, complemented by a globally shared reference anchor at every chunk to prevent error accumulation in long sequences without any additional training. Across standard video matting benchmarks and in-the-wild long footage, our framework outperforms prior diffusion-based methods in both fine-detail accuracy and temporal consistency, and uniquely maintains consistency across chunk boundaries on long videos.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video matting, the task of extracting foreground objects with pixel-level precision from video, is a fundamental component of video editing applications such as background replacement Zeng et al. (2025) ; Gao et al. (2025) ; Ren et al. (2024) , visual composition Dalva et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025a) , and relighting Chaturvedi et al. (2025) ; Ren et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; Choi et al. (2025) . Producing convincing composites in these settings requires alpha mattes that capture fine structures such as hair strands and motion-blurred edges, and that remain temporally consistent across the entire video.
blocks.zh: 视频相交,从视频中取出有像素级精度的前置物体的任务,是视频编辑应用的一个基本组成部分,如背景替代Zeng等人(2025年);Gao等人(2025年);Ren等人(2024年);视觉成分Dalva等人(2024年);Yang等人(2025年a年)和再点Chaturvedi等人(2025年);Ren等人(2024年);Wang等人(2025年);Choi等人(2025年)。 在这些环境中产生令人信服的复合物需要α matetes 捕捉精细的结构,如毛线和运动-blurred边缘, 在整个视频中保持时间一致性。

blocks.en:
Recent video matting methods leverage priors from video object segmentation models Huynh et al. (2024) ; Yang et al. (2025b) .
However, these methods still rely on dedicated matting annotations and offer limited zero-shot generalization, with most existing methods restricted to human portraits due to the scarcity of matting labels for other categories.
A more recent line of work instead leverages video diffusion priors Lim et al. (2026) ; Ge et al. (2025) , transferring generative knowledge obtained from internet-scale pretraining to close the train–test gap that arises when models are trained only on synthetic matting data.
In particular, VideoMaMa Lim et al. (2026) demonstrates that a mask-to-matte diffusion model trained on synthetic data alone can generalize to non-human categories and to in-the-wild video footage.
blocks.zh:
近期的视频平分方法利用视频对象分解模型的前科 Huynh等 (2024); Yang等 (2025b).
然而,这些方法仍然依赖于专用的交配说明,并且提供有限的零发一般化,由于其他类别的交配标签很少,大多数现有方法都局限于人类肖像.
更近期的工作是利用Lim等人(2026年)和Ge等人(2025年)的视频传播,转移从互联网规模的预训中获得的基因知识,以弥合在模型只接受合成配分数据培训时出现的火车测试差距。
特别是VideoMaMa 林等编. (2026年)证明,仅通过合成数据培训的口罩到相配的传播模型可以被概括到非人类类别和被覆盖的视频片段.

blocks.en: However, applying diffusion-based matting to real videos exposes a fundamental limitation that hinders general video processing. Diffusion backbones are computationally heavy and cannot process arbitrarily long sequences in a single forward pass; existing methods are therefore chunk-based, handling only 6–24 frames at a time. As a result, even ordinary videos must be split into multiple chunks and processed sequentially. When each chunk is matted independently from its coarse mask guidance, the resulting mattes drift across chunk boundaries, producing flickering edges and discontinuous transparency, as illustrated in Figure 1 (b). The root cause is the inherent ambiguity of coarse mask guidance: a single binary mask admits many plausible fine-grained refinements at object boundaries, and independently processed chunks settle on different ones.
blocks.zh: 然而,将基于传播的配乐应用到真实的视频中,暴露出一个根本的局限性,阻碍了一般的视频处理. 分散式主干线在计算上很重,不能任意处理单个前行通道中的长序;因此,现有方法都是以块为主的,每次只处理6到24帧. 因此,即使是普通的视频也必须被分割成多个块并相继处理. 如图1(b)所示,当每个块与粗口口罩制导分开交配时,产生的垫子会跨越块状边界,产生闪烁的边缘和不连续的透明度。 根本原因是粗口口罩指向的内在模糊:一个单一的二进制口罩在对象边界上承认了许多可能精细的改进,独立处理的块会在不同块上安放.

blocks.en: In this work, we present a novel mask-guided diffusion-matting framework designed for long, high-resolution video. At its core, we represent the two guidance modalities, the RGB frames and the coarse mask, as separate token streams alongside the noisy matte tokens, and let them interact through full spatio-temporal self-attention. This design replaces the channel concatenation used in prior U-Net-based diffusion matting Lim et al. (2026) and preserves each modality’s distinct structure. The high-frequency RGB texture carries hair and edge cues, while the binary mask provides a coarse but spatially anchored foreground extent, and attention adaptively composes the two at every layer and spatial location. As a result, the model leans on RGB at object boundaries where the mask is unreliable, and on the mask in the interior where it confidently localizes the foreground. We instantiate this on a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) Peebles and Xie (2023) ; Wan et al. (2025) with Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) Su et al. (2024) , which naturally accommodates diverse resolutions and frame counts.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了一个为长高分辨率视频设计的新型口罩制导的传播配对框架. 其核心是,我们代表两种指导模式,即RGB框架和粗口罩,作为与吵闹的相伴的相伴相伴相伴的符号流,让他们通过全面的斯皮提奥-时空自觉来互动. 这种设计取代了先前U-Net所使用传播分解Lim等人(2026年)所使用的信道接合,并保留了每种方式的不同结构。 高频RGB纹理会携带发型和边缘提示,而二进制口罩则提供粗糙但空间锚定的前地范围,注意力在每一个地层和空间位置上适应性地构成两者. 因此,该模型在面具不可靠的对象边界上倚靠RGB,而在内地的面具上则自信地将前地定位. 我们用一种扩散变形器(DiT) Peebles and Xie (2023); Wan et al. (2025) 和Rotary Patition Embedding (ROPE) Su等 (2024) 进行即时分析,这自然能容纳不同的分辨率和帧计数.

blocks.en: To resolve the chunk-boundary inconsistency described above, we introduce a novel pair of learnable token embeddings, the preserve token and the refine token , a new conditioning interface for consistent video matting. The preserve token marks a frame whose guidance is already a fine matte, previously generated or ground truth, and tells the model to keep it as a reference. The refine token marks a frame with only a coarse mask and asks the model to refine it into a fine matte consistent with the preserve-tagged references via DiT’s full self-attention. We employ these tokens in a sliding-window inference scheme in which each chunk overlaps a few preserve-tagged frames with the previous chunk, so that already-generated mattes propagate across chunk boundaries and maintain local temporal consistency. To further guard against error accumulation over long sequences, we additionally supply a globally reliable matte as a reference anchor at every chunk through the same preserve token, without any additional training.
blocks.zh: 为了解决上述的分块边界不一致问题,我们引入了一对新颖的可学习的标志嵌入物、保存物和精细物,这是用于一致的视频交配的新调节界面。 保存符标记出一个框架,其指导已经是一个精细的分解,以前生成的或地面的真理,并告诉模型保留它作为参考. 精细的装饰标志一个只有粗口罩的框架, 我们在滑动窗口推论方案中使用这些符号,其中每个块与上个块相重叠几个被保存标记的框,这样已经生成的垫子就可以跨块边界传播,并保持本地时间的一致性. 为了进一步防止在长的序列中积累出误差,我们还在没有任何额外训练的情况下,通过同一保护地,在每一个地块上提供全球可靠的垫子作为参照锚。

blocks.en: We validate our framework through extensive experiments on standard video matting benchmarks and in-the-wild footage. Our method outperforms existing video matting approaches on VideoMatte Lin et al. (2021) , YoutubeMatte Yang et al. (2025b) , and V-HIM60 Huynh et al. (2024) in both fine-detail accuracy and temporal consistency, and achieves state-of-the-art performance on long-video matting where prior diffusion-based methods fail to maintain consistency across chunk boundaries. The same preserve mechanism also gives users direct control at inference time, for example to interactively correct erroneous outputs by re-tagging specific frames as refine while keeping trusted neighbors as preserve.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对标准视频配分基准和模糊镜头的广泛实验验证我们的框架。 我们的方法在精细准确性和时间一致性上都超过了VideoMatte Lin等人(2021年)、YoutubeMatte Yang等人(2025年b月b日)和V-HIM60 Huynh等人(2024年)的现有视频交配方法,并在以往的传播方法无法维持分块界限的一致性的情况下,在长视频交配方面实现了最先进的性能。 同样的保存机制也让用户在推断时间直接控制,例如通过将特定帧重排为精细,同时保留被信任的邻居作为保存,从而交互纠正错误输出.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows. • A mask-guided diffusion-matting framework with token-level guidance representation , where the RGB frames and the coarse mask are kept as separate token streams adaptively composed by full spatio-temporal self-attention, rather than fused via channel concatenation as in prior works. • A novel preserve and refine token mechanism that enables chunk-consistent matting through sliding-window inference with overlap-based propagation, complemented by a globally shared reference anchor that prevents error accumulation in long sequences without any additional training. • State-of-the-art performance on standard video matting benchmarks and in-the-wild long-video footage, with substantial gains in fine-detail accuracy and temporal consistency over prior diffusion-based methods that process video chunk-wise.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Video matting methods can be broadly categorized into auxiliary-free and auxiliary-guided approaches Park et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2025a) . Auxiliary-free methods Lin et al. (2022) ; Ke et al. (2022) ; Li et al. (2024) typically focus on portrait matting, restricting their applicability to human-centric scenarios. Auxiliary-guided approaches relax this restriction by accepting additional conditioning at the cost of an extra annotation. Trimap-guided methods Huang and Lee (2023) ; Seong et al. (2022) require manual trimap annotations and cannot easily leverage modern segmentation models such as the SAM family Kirillov et al. (2023) ; Ravi et al. (2024) ; Carion et al. (2025) . More recent mask-guided methods reduce this burden by accepting only a coarse binary mask. MaGGIe Huynh et al. (2024) decouples target tracking from matting but struggles to generalize to in-the-wild videos, while MatAnyone Yang et al. (2025b) ; Yang et al. (2026) propagates target-assigned mattes through a memory-augmented architecture trained on dedicated matting datasets such as VM800 Yang et al. (2025b) and VMReal Yang et al. (2026) . Despite these advances, all of these methods remain constrained by predominantly synthetic and human-centric training data, leaving in-the-wild generalization to non-human categories largely unsolved.
blocks.zh: 视频编配方法可大致分为无辅助和辅助制导方法 Park等 (2023); Huang等 (2025a). 无辅助方法 Lin等 (2022年); Ke等 (2022年); Li等. (2024)一般注重肖像相配,限制其适用于以人为中心的情景. 辅助制导方法通过接受附加条件而以附加注释为代价来放松这一限制. 黄和李的三相制导方法(2023); Seong等人(2022年)需要手动三相图说明,无法轻易地利用现代分相模型,如SAM家族Kirillov等(2023年);Ravi等(2024年);Carion等(2025年). 更近期的口罩制导方法只接受粗口的二进制口罩来减轻这种负担. MaGGIe Huynh等人(2024年)将目标追踪从交配中解开,但努力将视频归纳为零散的视频,而MatAnyone Yang等人(2025年b; 杨等. (2026年)通过一个内存增强的架构来传播目标被分配的马提斯,该架构经过了专门编配数据集的培训,如VM800 Yang等 (2025年b)和VMREal Yang等 (2026年). 尽管取得了这些进步,但所有这些方法仍然受到主要以合成和以人为中心的培训数据的限制,使非人类类别的普遍化基本上得不到解决。

blocks.en: Diffusion priors from internet-scale pretraining have been transferred to dense perception tasks. Marigold Ke et al. (2024) pioneered this direction by adapting Stable Diffusion Rombach et al. (2022) for depth estimation, and the same recipe extends to a range of video perception tasks Bin et al. (2025) ; Shao et al. (2025) ; Hu et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025b) , with more recent works Xu et al. (2025a) ; Zhang et al. (2026) extending it to DiT-based backbones.
blocks.zh: 互联网规模预训的传播前科已转移到密集的认知任务上。 马里戈尔德 Ke等人(2024年)开创了这一方向,对Stable Difusion Rombach等人(2022年)进行了深度估计,同样的食谱还延伸到了一系列视频感知任务 Bin等人(2025年);Shao等人(2025年);Hu等人(2025年);Xu等人(2025年b),最近有著作 Xu等人(2025年a年); 张等(2026年)将其扩展至以DiT为主干.

blocks.en: Diffusion backbones, however, are computationally heavy and limited to short chunks, so applying them to long videos requires a chunk-wise inference scheme. ChronoDepth Shao et al. (2025) and DepthCrafter Hu et al. (2025) adopt sliding-window inference with overlapping frames between adjacent chunks for local temporal smoothness, but offer no global anchor against drift. A parallel line of work tackles this through auto-regressive generation Huang et al. (2025b) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Yin et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2025) ; Cui et al. (2025) ; Yang et al. (2025c) ; Ma et al. (2026) , where each chunk is conditioned on the previous chunk via causal attention with KV-cache reuse. While effective for free-form video generation, this hidden-state propagation does not naturally compose with explicit external conditioning such as a guide mask. Our work instead propagates fully-formed reference mattes between chunks through the preserve token, keeping each chunk fully conditioned on its own user-supplied mask.
blocks.zh: 然而,传播主干线在计算上很重,仅限于短块,因此将其应用到长相视频上需要一个分块推断方案. Chrono Depth Shao 等 (2025)和 DepthCrafter Hu等. (2025) 采用相邻块之间相接相接的相接框的滑动-窗口推论,用于局部时间平滑,但不能提供全球锚来抵御漂流. 平行的工作方针通过自动递归生成的黄克华等人(2025b)解决这个问题; Chen等 (2024); Yin等 (2025); Liu等 (2025); Cui等 (2025); Yang等 (2025c); Ma等 (2026),其中每个块通过KV-cache再利用的因果注意条件于上个块. 虽然对自由形式的视频生成有效,但这种隐藏状态的传播并不自然地由诸如向导口罩等明显的外设来组成. 相反,我们的工作是通过保存的符号在块之间传播完全成型的参考垫,使每个块都完全以自己的用户提供的口罩为条件。

blocks.en: In the matting domain, recent diffusion-based methods transfer video diffusion priors to video matting using only synthetic data. The auxiliary-free GVM Ge et al. (2025) and the mask-guided VideoMaMa Lim et al. (2026) both demonstrate that this prior generalizes to non-human categories and in-the-wild footage, but both inherit the chunk-wise inference limitation of prior diffusion-based perception models. VideoMaMa, the closest mask-guided baseline, additionally fuses RGB, mask, and noise via channel concatenation, entangling the guidance modalities and limiting fine-detail recovery. Our work departs from this design by representing the two guidance modalities as separate token streams, and by introducing the preserve and refine tokens that maintain chunk-wise consistency through globally shared reference anchors and overlap-based local smoothing.
blocks.zh: 在平分域中,以近代扩散为基础的方法转移视频平分传播前科,只使用合成数据进行视频平分. 辅助免费GVM Ge等 (2025)和口罩制导视频MaMa Lim等. (2026年)两者都表明,这之前的概括到非人类类别和被混淆的镜头,但两者都继承了之前以扩散为基础的感知模型的分块推论限制. 视频 MaMa,最接近的口罩制导基线,另外还有通过通道接合来导出RGB,口罩和噪声,将制导方式包围起来并限制精细回收. 我们的工作偏离了这一设计,将两种指导模式作为单独的象征流,并通过全球共享的参考锚地和基于重叠的局部平滑,引入了保持分块一致性的保存和精细标志。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of the VideoMaMa++ training and inference. (Top) During training, RGB frames are paired with either a binary mask or the ground-truth alpha matte as guide input, encoded into separate token streams by a frozen VAE encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} , and tagged with a refine token ( R ) or preserve token ( P ). The DiT processes both modes jointly within a single clip, supervised against the ground-truth matte. (Bottom) At inference, long videos are processed in a sliding-window manner. Each chunk receives the refine token on its non-overlapping frames and the preserve token on its overlap frames, which carry the previous chunk’s predicted matte. A globally selected reference anchor frame is additionally supplied as preserve input to every chunk, providing a stable anchor that prevents error accumulation across the sequence.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation and Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出和概述

blocks.en: Video matting is mathematically defined by the alpha compositing equation, I t = α t F t + ( 1 − α t ) B t , t = 1 , … , T , I_{t}=\alpha_{t}F_{t}+(1-\alpha_{t})B_{t},\quad t=1,\dots,T, (1) where t t denotes the frame index, T T is the total number of frames in the video, I t I_{t} is the observed image at frame t t , F t F_{t} is the foreground, B t B_{t} is the background, and α t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha_{t}\in[0,1] is the alpha matte representing pixel-level opacity. Unlike binary segmentation masks M ∈ { 0 , 1 } M\in\{0,1\} , alpha mattes capture fine-grained details such as hair strands, motion blur, and semi-transparent regions, which are critical for realistic video compositing.

We adopt a mask-guided formulation that decomposes video matting into two subproblems: foreground tracking and boundary refinement. Tracking a target object across a video is itself a demanding task, and entangling it with matte generation forces a single model to simultaneously localize objects and resolve pixel-level matting. By conditioning on a binary mask, we decouple these two challenges and allow our model to focus on generating fine-grained matting details such as hair strands and motion blur, while inheriting localization capabilities from off-the-shelf segmentation models Ravi et al. (2024) ; Carion et al. (2025) ; Cheng and Schwing (2022) ; Cheng et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 我们采用一种由口罩制导的配方,将视频分解成两个子问题:前地跟踪和边界完善. 通过视频跟踪一个目标物体本身就是一项艰巨的任务,用matte一代来将它包围,迫使一个单一的模型同时将物体本地化并解决像素级的交配. 通过对二进制口罩的调制,我们解开这两个挑战,使我们的模型能够专注于生成细纹的交配细节,如发纹和运动模糊等,同时从现成分化模型Ravi等人(2024年);Carion等人(2025年);Cheng和Schwing(2022年); 程等 (2024) (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: We design an end-to-end pipeline for long-video matting that takes a video and a single user prompt on the first frame as input, and produces a temporally consistent alpha matte across the entire sequence. The pipeline operates in three stages, illustrated in Figure 2 . First, we obtain a per-frame foreground signal by propagating the user prompt across all frames using an off-the-shelf video segmentation model such as Segment Anything Ravi et al. (2024) ; Carion et al. (2025) . Second, the resulting binary mask track is passed to our Diffusion Transformer (DiT) backbone together with the RGB frames to generate fine-grained alpha mattes (Section 3.2 ). Finally, long sequences are handled by a chunk-wise inference scheme equipped with preserve and refine tokens (Section 3.3 ), which propagates information across chunk boundaries to maintain temporal consistency throughout the video.
blocks.zh: 我们设计一个端到端的管道,用于长相相交配,将一个视频和一个用户在第一帧上的提示作为输入,并在整个序列中产生一个时间上一致的α相交. 如图2所示,管道分三个阶段运作。 首先,我们通过使用现成的视频分解模型,例如September Anything Ravi等(2024年);Carion等(2025年),传播用户在所有帧的提示,从而获得一个每帧前景信号。 其次,由此产生的二进制口罩轨迹会和RGB框架一起传递到我们的分化变形器(DIT)骨干上,以生成精致的alpha mattes(第3.2节. 最后,长序由配备有保存和精细标志的分块推论方案处理(第3.3节),它跨越分块边界传播信息,在整个视频中保持时间一致性。

blocks.en: 3.2 Repurposing Diffusion Transformer for Video Matting
blocks.zh: 3.2 重用分散变压器进行视频编组

blocks.en: Video matting annotations are scarce and limited in quantity and category coverage. Generalizing to real-world footage therefore requires a strong prior over natural video content. We build our framework on a video DiT Peebles and Xie (2023) ; Wan et al. (2025) backbone, which provides a rich generative prior learned from internet-scale video pretraining and offers several architectural properties well-suited to video matting.

blocks.en: 3.3 Preserve and Refine Tokens
blocks.zh: 3.3 保存和完善托肯斯

blocks.en: The formulation above operates on a single clip, while video matting in practice requires handling long sequences. DiT backbones are computationally heavy and cannot process long videos in a single forward pass. A natural solution is chunk-wise inference, where the video is split into fixed-length clips and each clip is processed independently. However, when each chunk is refined from its guidance in isolation, the resulting mattes drift across chunk boundaries, producing flickering edges and discontinuous transparency.
blocks.zh: 上面的配体运行在一个片段上,而视频在实际操作中交配则需要处理长序. DiT骨干在计算上很重,不能在一次前行通道中处理长视频. 一个自然的解决方案是分块推论,即将视频分为固定长片段,每个片段独立处理. 然而,当每个块孤立地从它的取向中提炼出来时,所产生的细毛就跨越了分块边界,产生闪烁的边缘和不连续的透明度。

blocks.en: To address this, we introduce two learnable token embeddings, a preserve token and a refine token , which assign each frame a per-frame mode that determines whether its matte is carried through unchanged or generated from coarse guidance. The preserve token marks anchor frames whose alpha mattes should be retained, while the refine token marks frames that should be converted from coarse guidance into fine-grained alpha mattes. DiT’s full self-attention propagates information from preserve frames to refine frames, yielding mattes that remain consistent across chunks.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了两个可以学习的活字符号嵌入,一个保存活字符号和一个精细活字符号,它指定了每个帧的每个帧模式,决定它的马垫是经过不变的还是由粗糙的导出. 保存的标志标记锚框,其α mattes应当被保留;而精细的标志标记框,应当从粗糙的导线被转换为细纹的α mattes. DiT 完全自觉地将信息从保存的帧传播到精细的帧, 并产生各个块之间一致的分量。

blocks.en: We chose to propagate fully-formed reference mattes through the preserve token rather than reuse the previous chunk’s key-value (KV) cache as in auto-regressive diffusion approaches Huang et al. (2025b) ; Yin et al. (2025) . Hidden-state propagation implicitly turns the model into a propagation-based matting framework, where each chunk’s prediction is determined more by the previous chunk’s internal state than by its own mask guidance. This re-entangles localization and fine-detail recovery, the two subproblems we explicitly decoupled by adopting mask-guided conditioning. The preserve token instead exposes the previous chunk’s contribution as an explicit alpha matte, so each chunk remains fully grounded in its own mask guidance while still receiving long-range temporal context through self-attention.
blocks.zh: 我们选择通过保存符来宣传完全成型的参考垫,而不是像在自动递回扩散方法Huang等人(2025年b)中那样重复使用以前的块键值缓存; 殷等 (2025) (中文(简体) ). 隐藏状态传播隐含地将模型变成一个基于传播的配方框架,其中每个块的预测多由上个块的内部状态决定,而不是由它自己的遮罩导出. 这重新纠缠了局部化和细细恢复,我们通过采用口罩制导来明确解开两个子问题. 相反,保存的标志暴露了前一个块的贡献是明显的alpha matte,因此每个块仍然完全以自己的口罩指导为基础,而同时通过自我观察仍能接受长距离的时间背景。

blocks.en: We train both tokens jointly within a single clip. For each training clip, we randomly select a subset of frames as preserve frames, replace their guide input with the ground-truth alpha matte, and add the preserve token embedding to those frames. The remaining frames receive the refine token together with the standard binary mask guide input. The model is supervised against the ground-truth matte at all frames through the pixel-level supervision, learning to reconstruct the supplied matte at preserve frames and to generate fine-grained mattes from coarse guidance at refine frames. Joint training within a single clip is essential, as it forces the DiT to learn a unified representation in which preserve and refine frames interact through self-attention, rather than treating them as two disjoint tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们在一个片段内联合训练两个标志。 对于每个训练片段,我们随机选择一个框子作为保存框,用地-真实的alpha matte来取而代之的引导输入,并在这些框子上添加保存符嵌入. 所剩的帧会连同标准的二进制口罩向导输入一起得到精制令牌. 该模型通过像素级的监理,在所有帧上与地-真实相配,学习在保存帧上重建所供应的相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相配相 在一个片段内进行联合培训至关重要,因为它迫使技术司学习一种统一的代表性,在这种代表性中,维护和完善框架通过自觉互动,而不是把它们视为两个不相干的任务。

blocks.en: 3.4 Temporally Consistent Inference
blocks.zh: 3.4 暂时一致的推论

blocks.en: We deploy the preserve and refine tokens at inference through two complementary mechanisms: a sliding-window scheme that propagates mattes between adjacent chunks for local consistency, and a reference anchor that supplies a globally reliable matte at every chunk to prevent long-range drift.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两个互补机制,即一个在相邻块之间传播相邻块间分层的滑窗计划,以及一个提供全球可靠的分层分层的参照锚,以防止远距离漂移。

blocks.en: At inference, we apply a sliding-window scheme in which consecutive chunks share an overlap region. The overlapping frames receive the previous chunk’s predicted matte as input together with the preserve token, so that their mattes are passed through unchanged, while the remaining frames receive the guide signal together with the refine token. Although the preserve token is applied only to the overlap frames, DiT’s full attention allows them to condition the generation of every other frame in the chunk, transferring temporal context across the chunk boundary and producing chunk-consistent mattes.
blocks.zh: 推论,我们采用一个滑动窗口方案,即连续块共享一个重叠区域。 相重叠的相框接收了上块所预测的相框同保存的相框一起作为输入,使其相框通过不变,而其余相框则与精密相框一起接收向导信号. 虽然保存的符号只适用于相重叠的相框,但DiT的全心全意允许它们设定块中每个相框的生成条件,将时间上下文移出相片边界并产生与相片相符合的相片垫.

blocks.en: The sliding-window scheme alone is vulnerable to error accumulation, since a corrupted overlap frame, e.g., due to occlusion, tracking drift, or other video artifacts, propagates through the preserve token to all subsequent chunks and cascades local failures through the rest of the video. To prevent this, we introduce a reference anchor , a globally reliable frame whose matte is supplied as preserve input alongside the local overlap frames at every chunk, providing a stable, error-free signal that the model can attend to throughout inference while the overlap frames continue to carry short-range temporal context. Crucially, this capability emerges directly from the preserve token without any additional training: because the preserve token already learns to treat its inputs as anchors, any user-supplied matte can serve as an anchor for the rest of the video.
blocks.zh: 光是滑窗计划就容易出错,因为一个腐烂的重叠框架,例如由于被掩埋、跟踪漂移或其他录像文物,通过保存符向随后的所有块传播,并通过录像的其余部分导致局部故障。 为了防止这种情况,我们引入了一个参考站点,即一个全球可靠的框架,在每一块的局部重叠框架外,还作为保存输入物提供垫子,提供稳定、无错误的信号,使模型能够处理整个推论,而重叠框架继续带有短距离的时间背景。 关键是,这种能力直接出自保存的地标,没有经过任何额外的训练:由于保存地的地标已经学会了将它的投入当作主播处理,任何用户提供的地标都可以作为其余视频的地标.

blocks.en: This design gives users explicit control over which frame anchors the inference. By default, we reuse the matte predicted at the first chunk as the reference anchor throughout the video, which we find sufficient for most sequences. When the first frame is unreliable due to heavy occlusion, motion blur, or partial visibility, the user can instead select a later frame with cleaner foreground appearance as the reference, allowing the entire sequence to be conditioned on the most informative anchor available.
blocks.zh: 这种设计使用户可以明确控制哪个帧锁定推断. 默认情况下,我们重用第一块预想的马提作为整个视频的参考主播,我们发现这足以满足大多数序列. 当第一帧由于被大量遮蔽,运动模糊,或部分能见度而不可靠时,用户可以取而代之地选择后帧以更清洁的前景外观作为参考,使得整个序列都以可获得的信息最多的锚为条件.

blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en:
We build VideoMaMa++ on top of the Wan 2.1 (1.3B) Wan et al. (2025) model, training on a combination of image and video matting datasets. To preserve the generative prior, we adapt the DiT to the video matting task using LoRA Hu et al. (2022) rather than fine-tuning the full backbone. Training uses 3-frame clips at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution, which provides sufficient capacity for both spatial detail and temporal modeling. At inference, we process the video in chunks of 6 frames with a 2-frame overlap between consecutive chunks, where one of the overlap frames is the reference anchor.
Although the training and inference settings differ in both frame count and chunking behavior, the model generalizes across them due to RoPE’s Su et al. (2024) relative position encoding, which removes the dependence on absolute resolution and clip length present in fixed positional embeddings.

我们在Wan 2.1 (1.3B)上建 VideoMaMa++ Wan等 (2025) 模型,图像和视频相配数据集组合培训. 为了保留先入为主,我们利用LORA Hu等人将DiT适应视频交配任务. (2022年)而非精细调整全骨干. 训练使用以1024×1024 1024\times 1024分辨率的3帧剪接,为空间细节和时间建模提供了足够的能力. 推论,我们用6个帧块处理视频,连续块块之间有2个帧相重叠,其中一个相重叠的帧是参考主播.
虽然在帧计数和分块行为上,培训和推论设置都不同,但是由于ROPE的Su等人,模型在它们之间通用。 (2024)相对位置编码,可以去除对固定位置嵌入中存在的绝对分辨率和剪接长度的依赖.

We compare VideoMaMa++ against representative video matting baselines, including MGM in-the-wild Park et al. (2023) , MaGGIe Huynh et al. (2024) , MatAnyone 2 Yang et al. (2026) , and VideoMaMa Lim et al. (2026) , on in-the-wild videos.
Figure 3 shows long videos that diffusion models (VideoMaMa and ours) cannot process in a single chunk. As shown in the figure, the comparison methods either fail to capture fine-grained details or produce flickering results across chunks that are inconsistent over the full video.
In contrast, VideoMaMa++ produces mattes that retain fine-grained boundary detail consistently throughout the sequence and remain stable across distant frames, demonstrating that our DiT-based generative prior, combined with the preserve and refine token mechanism, generalizes effectively to long-form footage well beyond the length seen during training.
We refer the reader to the supplementary material for additional comparisons that more clearly demonstrate temporal consistency in motion.

blocks.en: The preserve and refine tokens also enable selective refinement of individual frames within a chunk. Given an initial prediction, we identify the frame with the largest error against the ground-truth matte, mark it with the refine token, and mark the remaining frames with the preserve token. Re-running the model under this configuration regenerates the marked frame while attending to the others as anchors, producing a refined matte that draws on temporal context from the rest of the chunk. As illustrated in Figure 4(a) , this interactive procedure consistently improves matting quality, even though no new guide signal is provided. Quantitative results for interactive refinement are reported in the appendix.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Ablation study on reference anchor.

blocks.en: We ablate the reference anchor by comparing two sliding-window inference settings: w/o r. anchor , which uses previous chunk’s matte on the local overlap frames with preserve tokens, and w/ r. anchor , our full setting that additionally supplies the first-chunk matte as a reference anchor providing a global preserve input. As reported in Table 2 , adding the reference anchor yields consistent improvements across all six metrics on both benchmarks, with the largest gains on boundary-sensitive measures such as Gradient. This confirms that propagating preserve information through local overlaps alone leaves the model vulnerable to error accumulation, and that the global anchor effectively stabilizes long-range inference while preserving the cross-chunk information transfer enabled by the preserve token.

As shown in Figure 4(b) , the w/o r. anchor variant exhibits a steadily rising curve on both benchmarks, with MAD growing markedly by the final chunk. In contrast, the w/ r. anchor variant remains substantially flatter throughout the sequence, confirming that the reference anchor effectively suppresses error propagation across long videos.

blocks.en: We design a targeted experiment to verify that the preserve and refine tokens produce consistent mattes across chunk boundaries. Using a chunk size of 6 with an overlap of 2 frames, each overlap frame is generated twice: once as part of the preceding chunk and once as part of the following chunk. We measure the discrepancy between these two predictions for the same frame, which directly reflects how much the matte drifts when the model crosses a chunk boundary. The two settings differ only in how the overlap frames are treated by the second chunk: w/o preserve regenerates them independently from the coarse mask guidance, whereas w/ preserve marks them with the preserve token and conditions on the matte produced by the preceding chunk. To isolate the effect of the preserve token, the reference anchor is disabled in both settings. As reported in Table 4 , w/ preserve reduces both MAD and Gradient discrepancy by a large margin, confirming that the preserve token effectively transfers cross-chunk information and yields mattes that align across chunk boundaries rather than drifting into independently chosen refinements.

blocks.zh: 表5: 遮盖发电机的强度。

blocks.en:
To evaluate the robustness of our model to diverse binary mask sources, we measure performance on V-HIM60 Huynh et al. (2024) using XMem Cheng and Schwing (2022) , Cutie Cheng et al. (2024) , SAM2 Ravi et al. (2024) , and SAM3 Carion et al. (2025) as binary mask generators in Table 5 . The results show that the model maintains consistent performance across all mask generators, demonstrating its robustness to the choice of binary mask input.
Beyond the choice of generator, the model also tolerates local mask errors: when the guidance mask is wrong on individual frames of a chunk, such as missing thin structures or drift under motion blur, cross-frame attention to neighboring frames recovers the matte. If the tracker instead locks onto a wrong object for an entire sequence, the matte follows that track, a limitation shared by all mask-guided methods.

为了评价我们的模型对多种二进制口罩源的稳健性,我们用XMem Cheng和Schwing(2022)来测量V-HIM60 Huynh等人(2024)的性能. Cutie. Cheng等 (2024), SAM2 Ravi等 (2024), SAM3 Carion等 (2025)作为二进制口罩发电机在表5. 结果显示,该模型保持了所有口罩出厂器的一致性能,显示出其对选择二进制口罩输入的稳健性.
除了选择生成器外,模型还容忍了局部口罩出错:当指向口罩在块的单个帧上出错时,如缺失的薄结构或运动模糊下漂移,跨帧注意相邻相邻的帧会恢复地垫. 如果跟踪器锁定一个错误的对象来进行整个序列,则matte遵循该轨道,这是所有遮罩制导方法共享的限制.

blocks.en: We investigate replacing the binary guide mask with SAM’s raw logit map, which preserves the soft confidence information discarded by binarization (Figure 5 ). The structures most affected by this collapse, such as hair strands, thin wires, and motion-blurred edges, exhibit below-threshold logits that are removed entirely once the mask is binarized. We replace the guide mask track M M in Section 3.2 with a SAM logit map, encoded by the same VAE into a latent that substitutes for z M z_{M} in Eq. 2 , and retrain the model end-to-end with this logit conditioning rather than swapping inputs only at inference. As reported in Table 6(a) , the logit-conditioned variant outperforms its binary counterpart across all four metrics, confirming that soft confidence carries signals critical for fine-detail recovery. However, this gain does not transfer to in-the-wild videos, where the model overfits to SAM’s specific logit distribution. We therefore adopt binary masks as the default guidance.

blocks.en: (b) Channel vs. Token concat
blocks.zh: (b) 频道对Token concat

blocks.en: We compare two strategies for combining the RGB, mask, and noise inputs: channel concatenation, which stacks all three modalities along the channel axis into a single input tensor, and token concatenation, which appends each modality as a separate token stream. The channel-concat variant uses an expanded patch embedding to ingest the stacked input while keeping the rest of the DiT backbone identical to our model. Channel concatenation reduces the token sequence length and therefore the compute cost of self-attention, but as shown in Table 6(b) , it consistently underperforms token concatenation across all metrics. We attribute this to the loss of modality-specific information when the inputs are collapsed into a single tensor at the input stage.
blocks.zh: 我们比较两种结合RGB,口罩,和噪声输入的策略:通道接合,沿通道轴将所有三种模式都堆放成单个输入的收音机;和符号接合,将每个模式作为单独的符号流相接. Channel-concat的变体使用一个扩展的补丁嵌入来吸收堆积的输入,同时保持DiT主干线的其余部分与我们的模型完全相同. 通道接合会减少符号序列长度并因此减少自留心的计算成本,但如表6(b)所显示,它始终低于所有指标的符号接合。 我们将此归因于输入在输入阶段被倒塌成一个单一的调值时,模式特定信息的丢失.

blocks.en: Table 7 : Ablation on denoising steps.
blocks.zh: 表7: 取消提名的步骤。

blocks.en: We evaluate how the number of denoising steps at inference affects matting quality. Following the observation of GenPercept Xu et al. (2024) in monocular depth estimation, we find that a single denoising step is sufficient for the diffusion model to convert a binary mask into a high-quality alpha matte. As reported in Table 7 , additional denoising steps lead the model to over-refine the matte, degrading both boundary sharpness and overall accuracy. We therefore adopt single-step inference as the default, which also yields a substantial efficiency gain for large-scale video processing (Appendix G ).

blocks.zh: 表8:块大小的缩小。

blocks.en: Table 8 evaluates chunk sizes on V-HIM60 Huynh et al. (2024) , with the overlap fixed at 2 frames across all settings. A 6-frame chunk outperforms both smaller (3) and larger (12) settings. Small chunks restrict the temporal context available for DiT’s self-attention, whereas large chunks dilute the preserve frames’ influence, reducing stability. A 6-frame chunk optimally balances temporal context with an effective preserve signal, serving as our default.

blocks.en: Table 9 : Ablation on LoRA rank.
blocks.zh: 表9:关于LORA等级的规定。

blocks.en: We ablate the LoRA rank used to adapt the pretrained DiT for video matting. As reported in Table 9 , performance improves monotonically as the rank increases, with rank 512 achieving the best results across all six metrics. The lower-rank variants (64 and 128) underperform on boundary-sensitive measures such as Gradient and MAD-T, indicating that mask-to-matte refinement requires sufficient adapter capacity to learn the fine-grained boundary structure absent from the input mask. We therefore adopt rank 512 as our default, which provides the best matting quality while remaining substantially lighter than full fine-tuning of the DiT backbone to preserve generative prior.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了LORA等级 用来调整预训的DIT 用于视频交配 如表9所报告,随着军衔的提高,业绩单调提高,512级在所有6个衡量标准中都取得了最佳成绩。 下等分位的变体(64和128)在对边界敏感的措施上表现不佳,如Gradient和MAD-T,表明口罩到相配的改进需要足够的适配能力来学习输入口罩所没有的细纹边界结构. 因此,我们采用512级作为默认值,这提供了最佳的交配质量,同时比DiT主干线的完全微调要轻得多,以保留先入后出。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce VideoMaMa++, a diffusion transformer model that leverages generative priors for robust video matting, overcoming data scarcity. VideoMaMa++ introduces preserve and refine tokens that enable temporally consistent matting on long videos, addressing a fundamental limitation of diffusion-based approaches confined to short clips. We demonstrate that VideoMaMa++ achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse benchmarks while producing fine-grained, temporally consistent results on long in-the-wild videos. An annotation-free analysis further shows that our chunk-wise inference exhibits no measurable discontinuity at chunk boundaries, unlike VideoMaMa processing chunks independently. Nevertheless, VideoMaMa++ is more computationally demanding than feed-forward models and, like all mask-guided methods, depends on the upstream mask track; reducing the DiT inference cost and benchmarking temporal smoothness on real footage are promising future directions.
We believe VideoMaMa++ provides a scalable framework bridging the gap between short-clip generation and real-world long-video applications.

blocks.en: Appendix D AM-2K Justification
blocks.zh: 附录D AM-2K

blocks.en: We observe that the AM-2K Li et al. (2022) ground-truth annotations contain systematic errors that disproportionately penalize fine-detail predictions under the MAD metric. As illustrated in Figure 6 , the AM-2K ground truth often lacks detail within foreground regions, despite the predictions correctly recovering them. Because MAD averages absolute differences over the entire image, these annotation gaps inflate the reported error even when the predicted matte is visually superior. MAD-T, by contrast, restricts the evaluation to the transition region defined by the ground-truth trimap, isolating the boundary detail where matting quality matters most. Under this more reliable metric, VideoMaMa++ achieves state-of-the-art performance against all comparison methods, indicating that the apparent MAD gap on AM-2K reflects annotation noise rather than a true performance deficit.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,AM-2K Li等(2022年)地面实况说明含有系统性错误,不成比例地惩罚了MAD指标下的详尽预测。 如图6所示,AM-2K地面真相往往缺乏前景区域内的详情,尽管预测正确恢复了这些真相。 由于MAD平均对整个图像的绝对差异,这些注释空白会放大所报错误,即使预测的matte在视觉上优越. 相比之下,MAD-T将评价限制在地面真相三分图所定义的过渡区域,孤立了交配质量最重要的边界细节。 在这个更可靠的度量下,VideoMa++相对于所有比较方法,实现了最先进的性能,表明AM-2K上明显的MAD差距反映了注释噪声而不是真正的性能缺陷.

blocks.en: All mask-guided methods, including ours, receive the identical guidance mask track for every sequence, generated by Algorithm 1 . We binarize the ground-truth alpha matte of the initialization frame and prepend a duplicate of that frame to the video; for the default first-frame initialization, SAM3 Carion et al. Every frame’s guidance mask, including that of the initialization frame itself, is therefore a SAM3 prediction rather than the binarized ground truth. The initialization frame is the first frame for every sequence, with the single exception described below. No method therefore receives a privileged mask.

blocks.en: For all evaluations, the input masks are obtained automatically without human intervention, with one exception. The static_0017 sequence from YouTubeMatte Yang et al. (2025b) presents a granularity ambiguity at the first frame: a sheet of paper that becomes part of the foreground only enters the scene partway through the video, and is therefore not visible at the moment of mask initialization. As a result, when SAM3 Carion et al. (2025) is prompted on the first frame, the resulting mask track captures only the subject and cannot recover the paper once it appears, as shown in Figure 7 . Because mask-guided matting models, including MaGGIe Huynh et al. (2024) , VideoMaMa Lim et al. (2026) , and ours, faithfully follow the granularity defined by the input mask, the paper is consequently excluded from the predicted alpha matte. To resolve this without manual annotation, we initialize SAM3 on a later frame (frame 60) where both the subject and the paper are simultaneously visible, and propagate the prompt across the entire sequence. This re-initialized track is used for all mask-guided methods. We note that the MatAnyone Yang et al. (2025b) ; Yang et al. (2026) series is not affected by this issue, as it does not rely on an external mask track. We report this exception in the interest of full transparency.
blocks.zh: 对所有评价来说,输入口罩都是在没有人类干预的情况下自动获得的,只有一个例外. 由YouTubeMatte Yang等(2025b)出品的静态_0017序列在第一帧呈现出颗粒性模糊:一张成为前地一部分的纸片只通过视频进入场景部分,因此在口罩初始化的瞬间看不到. 因此,当SAM3 Carion等(2025)被第一个框架所激发时,所产生的口罩轨道只捕捉到被试对象,一出纸就无法取回,如图7所示. 由于口罩制导的交配模型,包括MaGGIe Huynh等 (2024),VideoMa Lim等 (2026),以及我们的,忠实地遵循了输入口罩所定义的颗粒性,因此纸被排除出所预测的α相交. 为了解决这个问题,不做手动注释,我们将SAM3在后方框架(frame 60)上初始化,其中主体和纸张同时可见,并在整个序列中传播提示. 这种被重新初始化的音轨被用于所有口罩制导方法. 我们注意到MatAnyone Yang等人(2025年b); 杨等 (2026年)系列不受这个问题的影响,因为它不依赖外口罩道. 我们报告这一例外是为了充分透明。

blocks.en: Ground-truth alpha mattes are unavailable for long real-world footage, so reference-based temporal metrics such as dtSSD cannot be computed on in-the-wild videos (Section I ). Chunk-wise inference, however, has a characteristic failure mode that can be measured without annotation: a discontinuity where separately processed chunks meet. We therefore introduce a ground-truth-free test for such discontinuities.

blocks.en: This section details the reference-anchor experiments of Table 3 , all conducted on V-HIM60 Huynh et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍表3的参照基准实验,这些实验都是在V-HIM60 Huynh等人(2024年)上进行的。

blocks.en: The first frame may not be representative of later frames. We therefore replace it as the anchor with a random frame or the last frame of the first chunk, which leaves performance nearly unchanged across all metrics. Because the foreground may also change in appearance over long sequences, we further re-anchor to a recent frame every 3 chunks. V-HIM60 sequences contain substantial pose, scale, and appearance variation, yet refreshing yields nearly identical quality to the default setting, so a first-frame anchor does not become stale on this benchmark. Refreshing nevertheless remains available at negligible cost for footage whose appearance changes more drastically.
blocks.zh: 第一个框架可能不能代表后一个框架。 因此,我们把它取而代之,取而代之的是第一组的任意框架或最后框架,使所有指标的性能几乎保持不变。 因为前景也可能随着长序变化而改变外观,所以我们进一步重新锁定到最近的相框每3个块. V-HIM60序列包含巨大的姿势,尺度和外观变异,然而刷新的质量与默认设置几乎相同,因此第一个帧锚不会在这个基准上变得僵化. 然而,对于外观变化更显著的镜头,仍以可忽略不计的成本进行刷新。

blocks.en: We corrupt the input of the first frame, which serves as the anchor, rather than the propagated matte. Because the anchor is the model’s own first-frame prediction, a corrupted input yields a degraded anchor matte that is propagated to all later chunks. We consider three corruptions: • Poor guidance mask. We erode (under-segmentation, E) or dilate (over-segmentation, D) the first-frame guidance mask using grayscale morphology with a square kernel of k ∈ { 5 , 21 } k\in\{5,21\} px. • Motion blur. We apply a horizontal motion-blur kernel of k ∈ { 7 , 15 , 25 } k\in\{7,15,25\} px to the first-frame RGB (B), so the model must matte a motion-blurred appearance. • Occlusion. We composite a real animal foreground from AM-2K Li et al. (2022) over the subject using its ground-truth matte, enlarging it until at least 99% of the subject is covered, and zero the occluded region of the guidance mask so that it remains consistent with the now-invisible subject (Occ.). We exclude the corrupted first frame from evaluation, so the metrics measure how the degraded anchor propagates to the rest of the video. This matters most under occlusion, where the input RGB and the ground-truth matte of the first frame disagree. It is also why the clean baseline in Table 3 b differs slightly from the main results: the only difference is the excluded clean first frame.

Full occlusion is the most severe case, followed by motion blur and poor guidance masks, and larger kernels generally lead to slightly larger degradation. blocks.en: Appendix I Limitation
blocks.zh: 附录一 限制

blocks.en: VideoMaMa++ deliberately separates tracking, delegated to a mask generator such as SAM3 Carion et al. (2025) , from matting, so its robustness is bounded by the quality of the mask track. Errors confined to individual frames of a chunk, such as missing thin structures or drift under motion blur, can be corrected through cross-frame attention to neighboring frames or through interactive refinement (Section B ). However, if the tracker locks onto the wrong object for an entire sequence, the matte follows that wrong track. This limitation is shared by all mask-guided matting methods.
blocks.zh: VideoMa++故意将跟踪分离出,下放给SAM3 Carion等(2025)等口罩生成器,与交配,因此其稳健性被口罩轨道的质量所约束. 局限于块块的单个框架的错误,如缺失的薄结构或运动模糊下漂移,可以通过跨框架注意相邻框架或通过交互改进来纠正(B节)。 然而,如果跟踪器锁定错误对象进行整个序列,则matte遵循错误的轨道. 这种限制由所有口罩制导的交配方法共同使用.

blocks.en:
A key limitation of this work, and of video matting research more broadly, is the absence of a benchmark that can rigorously evaluate temporal smoothness on real video. Existing benchmarks Lin et al. (2021) ; Yang et al. (2025b) ; Lim et al. (2026) are constructed by compositing per-frame foregrounds onto random backgrounds, which provides accurate per-frame ground truth but does not capture the temporal dynamics of naturally captured footage.
As a result, temporal consistency on real-world videos is still largely assessed qualitatively. The annotation-free seam test of Section F quantifies one specific failure mode, discontinuities at chunk boundaries, without ground truth. However, it measures neither per-frame accuracy nor flicker within a chunk, and it applies only to methods that process video in chunks, so it cannot compare the overall temporal behavior of arbitrary methods.
Developing a benchmark with reliable ground-truth temporal smoothness, ideally captured rather than composited, remains an open problem for the community.
blocks.zh:
这项工作以及更广泛的视频配乐研究的一个关键限制是缺乏一个能够严格评价真实视频时间平滑度的基准。 现有基准Lin等人(2021);Yang等人(2025b); Lim等人(2026年)通过将每帧前地堆放到随机背景来构建,这提供了每帧地上准确的真相,但没有捕捉到自然捕获的镜头的时间动态.
因此,对现实世界视频中的时间一致性仍基本上进行定性评估。 F节的无注解接合试验量化了一种特定的故障模式,即断断续续的断裂边界,没有地面真理。 然而,它既不测量每帧的准确性,也不在块内闪烁,它只适用于以块来处理视频的方法,因此不能比较任意方法的总体时间行为.
对社区来说,制定可靠的地面真实时间平稳的基准仍然是个公开的问题。

blocks.en: Appendix J Societal Impact
blocks.zh: 附录J 影响

blocks.en: Our mask-guided video matting framework can substantially benefit creative industries, education, and communication. By reducing the manual effort required for high-quality video matting, the method lowers the barrier to professional-grade video production, enabling independent creators, educators, and small studios to produce polished content without specialized expertise or costly proprietary software. In film and visual effects, it can accelerate labor-intensive rotoscoping workflows, allowing artists to focus on creative decisions rather than frame-by-frame manual labeling. The technology also improves the quality of background replacement in video conferencing and virtual classrooms, supporting remote collaboration and accessibility-oriented applications such as isolating speakers or interpreters in educational content.
blocks.zh: 我们的蒙面制导视频配乐框架可以大大地有益于创意产业、教育和交流。 通过减少高质量视频配乐所需的人工努力,该方法降低了专业级视频制作的障碍,使独立创作者,教育工作者,以及小工作室能够在没有专业知识或昂贵的专有软件的情况下制作被抛光的内容. 在电影和视觉效果中,它可以加速劳动密集型的轮廓扫描工作流程,使艺术家能够专注于创造性决策,而不是逐帧的人工标签. 该技术还提高了视频会议和虚拟教室背景替换的质量,支持远程协作和面向无障碍的应用程序,如将讲者或口译隔离在教育内容中。

blocks.en: Despite these benefits, high-quality video matting can be misused. As a core component in video manipulation pipelines, improved matting may facilitate the creation of more convincing deepfakes and manipulated media, contributing to misinformation and the erosion of public trust in video evidence.
blocks.zh: 尽管有这些好处,高质量的视频配乐可能会被滥用. 作为录像操纵管道的核心组成部分,改进配制可能有利于制造更有说服力的深层假象和被操纵的媒体,助长错误信息,并削弱公众对录像证据的信任。
